name: punho-livre
description: Punho Livre: jogo de luta 2.5D em Rust (WebAssembly) para navegador e Android

scripts.apk: ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease -PallowTestAds=true && mkdir -p dist && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk dist/punho-livre.apk
scripts.aab: ./android/gradlew -p android bundleRelease -PallowTestAds=true && mkdir -p dist && cp android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab dist/punho-livre.aab
